_comment: Template only -- run `alexa-ai new mcp` to generate the real package. Alexa+ needs a PUBLIC https URL (e.g. cloudflared tunnel to :8899), account linking (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE S256), and the MCP Toolkit is US-only. Fill the listing fields within Amazon's limits.
shortDescription: Know what's in your fridge and what to cook, using on-device vision.
fullDescription: Smart Fridge connects Alexa+ to a camera-equipped fridge. Ask what you have, what is about to spoil, or what to cook for dinner. Vision runs locally for privacy.
examplePhrases: Alexa, what can I make for dinner?
